source.title: Blizzard Hotfixes running list headed October 16, 2024 — entry under August 29, 2024
source.author: Blizzard Entertainment

quote: Improved the rate of prospecting gems for Bismuth, Ironclaw Ore, and Aqirite.
notes: CORRECTION OF SOURCE ENTRY DATE, not a second improvement: Blizzard's running hotfix article is titled October 16, 2024, but the quoted Jewelcrafting note appears under its August 29, 2024 section, not the October 16 entry. Research/v3/rate-changes.jsonl currently misdates this exact same wording to 2024-10-16. Master should re-date that existing event, deduplicate the two identical claims, and re-evaluate study epochs: September and October 1-15 samples are post-Aug29 gem buff but pre-Oct25 byproduct hotfix; neither 2024-10-16 gem buff nor any measured rate magnitude is established from this page. Exact affected ore input IDs Bismuth 210930/210931/210932, Aqirite 210933/210934/210935, Ironclaw 210936/210937/210938. No cast totals, hits, or numeric buff size are given.
affects: Bismuth (210930/210931/210932), Aqirite (210933/210934/210935), Ironclaw Ore (210936/210937/210938); baseline gem chances and ore-quality scaling
wording: Improved the rate of prospecting gems for Bismuth, Ironclaw Ore, and Aqirite.
